Le train s'ébranle, les rails crient mon nom.
J'laisse derrière moi les cendres et les frissons.

[Chorus]

[Chorus]

C'est la fin du voyage, j'efface nos pas.

Ouais.

Faded chalk lines on the pavement.

Leaving all the broken pieces far behind.

[Chorus]
Faded chalk lines on the pavement.
Faded chalk lines, where did the days go?
Washing in the rain, fading in the grey.
Childhood ghosts are here to stay.

Ghosts stay.

Yeah, fading out.
